subj.label: nyang bran pa chos kyi ye shes (3876)

relations.zotero_refs: [5RXEUKD9]: 523, No. 11334: de'i {=Zhang tshe spong} slob ma nyang brang pa chos kyi ye shes [...] mdzad pa'i rgyud bla ma'i Tik+ka.

comments:
A commentary by "Nyang bran" is mentioned by 'Gos lo tsA ba (ID:5839) and listed in A khu ching Shes rab rgya mtsho's Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 523, No. 11334: de'i slob ma nyang brang pa chos kyi ye shes [...] mdzad pa'i rgyud bla ma'i Tik+ka). 
See [ENNZCF55]: 66 and [BAQ9MH4T]: 408.

According to 'Gos lo tsA ba, this commentary was based on the commentaries of Gro lung pa (see (ID:6579)) and Zhang tshes spong (see (ID:6580)), themselves based on the small commentary by rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:4441). See [7V8MZYAI]: 4 (rngog gis rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa la TI kA chung yang mdzad cing | de la brten nas gro lung pa dang | zhang tshes kyis kyang TI kA mdzad de | de gnyis la brten nas nyang bran gyis kyang TI kA mdzad la |).
